context: a letter from C. C. Babington, which you are answering
exchanges:
I send a few seeds; all that we have.

I am told that Le Coq⁠⟨⁠,⁠⟩⁠ who has published a voluminous work on the Geograph. Distrib. of Europæan plants mentions not a few instances of apparent dimorphism.

Yours truly | Charles C. Babington—

I received the seeds this morning, which are real treasures to me, & I am sincerely obliged.— I have already looked through Lecoq’s gigantic & tedious Book.—

With many thanks, | Yours very sincerely | C. Darwin
